title: Rational learning parameter
statement: Let the input specify a positive dimension $n$, positive integers $a$ and $b$ with $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $B\ge1$. Its learning parameter is the rational number $a/b$, which lies in $(0,1/2]$.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier bound $B$ is at least $1$
